verdict.rationale: Keycloak exposes a full Admin REST API and ships the kcadm.sh Admin CLI for scripted management of realms, users, roles, and clients, plus JSON import/export of realms — all of which let an automation/AI agent script operations across many items rather than click through the UI. However, there is no documented dedicated 'bulk operation' endpoint (e.g., batch user creation/deletion in one call), and community experience notes the Admin API is 'inconsistent' and hard to keep idempotent when driving it via automation (Ansible), suggesting friction for large-scale programmatic bulk changes. Missing for 10: explicit bulk/batch API endpoints, first-party bulk-operation tooling or examples, and independent confirmation that large-scale scripted bulk operations work smoothly.
